rows.grounds: compound of pitāmaha (grandfather) and dhana (wealth); object of harec
introduces the condition under which taking is allowed
compound of mṛta (dead) and mātṛkā (mother); describes the eligible heir

items.question: Under what condition may a motherless heir claim the paternal grandfather's wealth?
premises: The wealth in question belongs to the paternal grandfather.
The potential heir is described as having a deceased mother.
The act of taking this wealth is presented as conditional.
items.inference: If the mother is dead, the motherless heir may take the paternal grandfather's wealth.
uncertainties: The exact referent of mṛtamātṛkā (daughter or child in general) is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O gentle one, if her mother is dead, she may take the grandfather's wealth.
